title: Incident Response Security Engineer
description:
About ClickHouse

Established in 2009, ClickHouse leads the industry with its open-source column-oriented database system, driven by the vision of becoming the fastest OLAP database globally. The company empowers users to generate real-time analytical reports through SQL queries, emphasizing speed in managing escalating data volumes. Enterprises globally, including Lyft, Sony, IBM, GitLab, Twilio, HubSpot, and many more, rely on ClickHouse Cloud. It is available through open-source or on AWS, GCP, Azure, and Alibaba.

The Security Team is responsible for providing key security capabilities covering application, cloud and enterprise security, incident response, detection and GRC. Our team is looking for an experienced, hands-on security practitioner, who will drive the adoption of modern security processes and tooling, with focus on supporting our detection and incident response capabilities.

What you will do:


 * Develop processes, tooling and automation to scale incident management response and mitigate risks to the business
 * Collaborate with other security functions, engineering, product, support, business operations to identify appropriate detection use cases and automation
 * Apply a threat modeling centric approach to incident detection and response
 * Maintain security logging platform
 * Stay up to date with the latest threats, attack vectors to improve our detection mechanisms and attack surface management
 * Handle information security events and incidents across the ClickHouse products and services
   
   
   

What you bring along:


 * Background in product security / red teaming / penetration testing / threat modeling, combined with incident detection and response experience
 * Strong knowledge of and experience with one or more cloud service providers (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 * Experience securing large-scale customer-facing cloud infrastructures
 * Significant development and automation experience; preference for Golang and Python
   
   
   

Bonus Points:


 * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or related field
 * Previous contributions to open source projects
 * Security or cloud related certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure)

An individual’s placement within the range will depend on various factors, including (but not limited to) education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location, performance, and the needs of the business or organization.

If you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at paytransparency@clickhouse.com.

Perks

 * Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 * A $500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of our first 500 employees, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: Endpoint Security Specialist - Global Technology Operations (GTO)
description:
Functiebeschrijving

Wil jij met jouw expertise helpen om aanvallen van binnen- en buitenaf in onze digitale wereld te voorkomen en je kennis inzetten in de strijd tegen cybercrime?

Jouw rol in ons team

Als Endpoint Security Specialist maak je deel uit van het Managed Security Services (MSS) team, dat 24/7 beveiligingsdiensten levert om onze klanten te beschermen tegen cyberaanvallen. Je levert verschillende EDR-diensten aan klanten wereldwijd en bent verantwoordelijk voor dagelijkse operationele beveiligingsprocessen, zoals vulnerability- en compliancy management, het testen en implementeren van nieuwe security oplossingen en het onderhoud van security producten.

Je behandelt gedetecteerde dreigingen en kwetsbaarheden uit systemen zoals firewalls, malware- virusscanning en content scanning, onder leiding van een architect, remote en vanuit ons SOC in de Randstad op basis van een 24x7 dienstverlening. Je werkt zelfstandig en proactief om de dienstverlening te verbeteren en implementeert, onderhoudt en monitort beveiligingsplatformen zoals CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne en Trellix.

Daarnaast ondersteun je klanten bij incidenten, werk je samen met global SOC-engineers en andere security-afdelingen en adviseer je over cyberbeveiligingsmaatregelen. Je ondersteunt ons offshore team in India dat 1e en 2e lijns support verleent en neemt deel aan standby-diensten voor het oplossen van P1/P2 incidenten.

Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Je bent nieuwsgierig, integer en analytisch sterk, met een focus op kwaliteit, functionaliteit en veiligheid. Dit vraagt een hoge mate van flexibiliteit en kennis van verschillende aspecten binnen het vakgebied. Je bent gedreven om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen en hebt een leergierige en proactieve werkhouding. Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en Engels en bent communicatief vaardig.

Daarnaast heb je:


 * Een afgeronde HBO/ WO opleiding met ICT component of een afgeronde MBO opleiding met HBO werk- en denkniveau of relevante werkervaring aangevuld met praktijkdiploma’s;
 * Minimaal 2 jaar technische werkervaring met Endpoint Security oplossingen;
 * Ervaring met het beheren van in ieder geval Microsoft Defender en/of CrowdStrike, maar daarnaast is kennis van SentinelOne en de Trellix (voorheen McAfee) suite wenselijk;
 * Ervaring met het oplossen van complexe security incidenten (3e lijns) en problemen;
 * Ervaring met het beheren van een security platform, het uitvoeren van regulier onderhoud, updates en upgrades.
 * Ervaring met het maken van een security design, alsmede het opzetten en uitvoeren van operationele security processen waaronder security incident management, threat management en vulnerability management is een pré.

title: Expert Security Analyst – Incident Coordinator – Security Incident Response Team
description:

As an Expert Security Analyst – Incident Coordinator, you will take a leadership role within the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT). Your primary focus will be on high/critical-level security incident response (Cyber, IT, OT, DLP, Physical, and driving strategic security improvements. You will also play a key role in mentoring analysts and shaping the organization’s security posture.

This position requires deep technical expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to lead complex security investigations and security improvements.

Role and Responsibilities

The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) operates within the Security Operations Center (SOC) to detect and mitigate security threats in real time. As an Expert security Analyst, you will be responsible for both operational security monitoring and security improvements.


 * Security Monitoring – Actively monitor security alerts for malicious activity or anomalies, ensuring swift response.
 * Incident Handling – Lead investigations into high-profile, complex, or advanced persistent threats (APTs).
 * Threat Hunting – Proactively search for hidden threats and improve detection capabilities.
 * Incident Analysis – Correlate data across multiple sources to detect sophisticated attack patterns.
 * Detection & Response Optimization – Develop advanced detection techniques and security automation strategies.
 * Technology Leadership – Act as an SME for SecOps tools and threat domains.
 * Mentorship & Training – Provide guidance and mentorship to analysts at all levels.
   
   

Education and experience

We Seek An Experienced Security Expert With a Strategic Mindset And a Proven Ability To Handle Complex Security Challenges. The Ideal Candidate Will Have


 * Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
 * 7+ years experience in advanced cybersecurity roles.
 * Experience working with stakeholders in a complex organization.
 * Proven record of influencing upper management towards security best practices.
 * Expertise in Security Monitoring, Log Analysis, and Threat Hunting
 * Deep knowledge of a wide range of domains such as Endpoint, Network, OT, Information and Cloud Security.

Skills

title: Pentesting Coordination
description:
In a glance

The Domain Expert - Pentesting coordination, manages and facilitates penetration testing activities. This role ensures that penetration tests are executed effectively, efficiently, and in alignment with security policies and objectives. You act as a central point of contact for all things related to penetration testing (e.q. scheduling, execution and reporting). This also includes managing relationships with external penetration testing vendors, ensuring adherence to agreements and deliverables.

Your job

You are responsible for aligning internal teams and external vendors to streamline execution of penetration tests, keeping track of planning and ensuring all testing activities comply with regulatory standards and organizational policies. You work in a team and together develop penetration testing schedules in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. You act as the primary point of contact for different projects and keep a detailed record of scope, timelines and outcomes for the penetration tests. You help solving penetration testing related questions, take initiative and escalate in time if needed. You signal improvements related to the way of working inside the team and you contribute to improving the maturity and coverage of our service offering.

Work environment

As a Domain Expert - Pentesting Coordination at ABN AMRO in Amstelveen, you will be an integral part of the internal Security Assurance team within the Corporate Information Security Office (CISO). Our team operates in an informal and collaborative manner, providing a diverse range of opportunities for continuous personal and professional development. With ABN AMRO's agile approach to work, we emphasize speed, productivity, agility, and innovation in everything we do.

Your fluency in English, both verbal and written, will be essential for effective communication across various departments within the bank. With excellent communication and interpersonal skills, you possess the ability to forge positive business relationships with stakeholders, ensuring alignment and collaboration in achieving security objectives.

Taking ownership of your own and the team's delivery, coupled with a proactive attitude, will drive successful outcomes in your role. Your ability to work collaboratively in a team environment is key, fostering an interactive and inspiring workplace where innovative solutions are developed and shared.

This role presents a unique opportunity to contribute to the bank's security initiatives while advancing your skills in a supportive and forward-thinking setting. Your engagement in this dynamic environment will be instrumental in coordinating pentesting efforts and enhancing the bank's security posture.

Your profile

Required skills:


 * You have approximately 3 - 5 years of relevant work experience in cyber security, security testing and penetration testing.
 * You have a good understanding of penetration testing methodologies and tools.
 * You have experience with operating systems, middleware, web applications, mobile applications & cloud environment.
 * You have experience with network architectures.
   
   
   

Wij bieden

We offer a challenging job and you are directly responsible for your own successes. We will stimulate every opportunity to work on personal development and developments to keep on top of your technical knowledge. At ABN AMRO, we use our knowledge, expertise and network to help our clients within and outside the Netherlands achieve their goals based on responsible decisions. Our clients’ interests always come first. We want clients to understand our products, and we sometimes say ‘no’ if a product involves a risk that is too high for the client. Putting clients’ interests first also means communicating in plain language and crafting smart solutions that genuinely make a difference. That is our goal.

title: Cyber Security Specialist
description:
Who we are

We're a specialized cybersecurity team working on safety-critical automotive systems. Our expertise in reverse engineering complex platforms enables us to uncover vulnerabilities and analyze proprietary implementations. Our work spans the entire security lifecycle, from early product design to veriﬁcation. We design and build complete security solutions based on our research ﬁndings, automate security assessments, and develop both offensive and defensive capabilities to establish robust security boundaries for critical systems. Our team works directly with manufacturers, translating security requirements into concrete implementations while guiding architecture decisions against realistic threats.




What we do

 * Reverse engineer custom security solutions to identify weaknesses
 * Build custom offensive and defensive tools to aid in research
 * Reverse engineer, design, and implement security solutions from the ground up
 * Consult on product designs, translating security requirements into concrete implementations
 * Work directly with clients, guiding security architecture decisions
 * Transform theoretical security concepts into practical implementations that protect critical systems




Technical areas

Our work spans several demanding technical domains:

 * RF/Wireless Signals Analysis: Researching secure communication protocols and wireless implementations
 * Vulnerability Research: Discovering security issues through systematic investigation and creating effective mitigations
 * Security Tool Development: Building specialized offensive and defensive tools that both attack and protect critical systems
 * Advanced Analytics: Creating analytical frameworks that process security-relevant data at scale
 * Architecture Assessment: Designing secure system architectures and evaluating security across integrated components
 * Firmware Security: Researching secure ﬁrmware architectures and validating existing implementations to ensure security boundaries
 * Hardware Analysis: Analysis of secure hardware designs and identifying weaknesses in physical components
 * Mobile OS Security: Reverse engineering and penetration testing of Android (preferred), iOS, Blackberry, etc. Researching interactions between operating systems & low-level components with application logic.




This challenging work demands technical precision, creative problem-solving, and security engineering from first principles. Our cybersecurity team includes specialists who can both build and break complex systems.




Why Join Us

 * Design and build security solutions that protect critical automotive systems
 * Work from ﬁrst principles to create both offensive and defensive security capabilities
 * Build meaningful client relationships with major manufacturers
 * Work with cutting-edge equipment and computing resources
 * Develop professionally through challenging projects and knowledge sharing
 * Enjoy work ﬂexibility with balanced scheduling options
 * Collaborate in our modern Eindhoven ofﬁce with dedicated labs
 * Join an international team (Hallo! Hoi! 你好! ¡Hola! Привет! ﻣرﺣﺑﺎ!)




Who you are:

You are either a skilled reverse engineer or a developer who thrives working alongside reverse engineers. You have strong skills in either system security assessment or secure development, with interest in growing across both domains. You might excel at ﬁnding vulnerabilities through reverse engineering or at building secure implementations and tooling. You take initiative on problems within your expertise while collaborating on challenges outside it. You communicate technical concepts effectively and appreciate the importance of teamwork in security research. You approach your work with appropriate care, recognizing the safety implications of automotive systems. We don't expect mastery of every skill — we're looking for specialists who want to learn and contribute to a balanced security team.




Required for all candidates:

 * Experience with reverse engineering or software development in at least one compiled language that produces native machine code (C/C++, Rust, Go, etc.)
 * Demonstrated technical writing skills for detailed documentation of architecture, ﬁndings, and methodologies
 * Technical curiosity and methodical investigation skills




Specialized skills (candidates should have at least one):

 * Skills in reverse engineering complex systems with minimal documentation
 * Analytical approach to ﬁnding technical weaknesses
 * Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences
 * Risk analysis and application of technical regulations to technical architecture
 * Public speaking and technical knowledge sharing
 * Advanced development skills, such as: Linux primitives, Big-data, Binary protocol manipulation, etc.




Why Join NavInfo Europe

At NavInfo Europe (NIE), based in the innovative Brainport Eindhoven region, we pioneer automotive cybersecurity, AI-driven data compliance, and advanced navigation solutions. As part of NavInfo's global ambition to become the digital brain behind intelligent driving, our European team specializes in:

 * Cybersecurity Services: Reverse engineering, vulnerability discovery, and security tooling.
 * AI and Compliance: Cutting-edge anonymization methods, GDPR compliance, and smart data curation.
 * Navigation Data Innovation: Precision mapping and data-driven mobility insights.




We continuously evolve our services, striving for faster delivery, higher quality, and innovative security standards that directly impact global mobility.




What You Can Expect:

 * Innovation-first Environment: Be at the forefront of technologies shaping secure and intelligent mobility solutions.
 * Continuous Growth: Expand your expertise with diverse challenges and professional development opportunities.
 * Collaborative & Diverse Team: Join an international, and collaborative team driven by technical excellence.
 * Attractive Benefits: Enjoy competitive compensation and flexible working arrangements tailored to support your personal and professional growth.




Are you driven by securing tomorrow’s mobility? Then we like to welcome aboard!




Application Process

To apply, please submit the following:

 * CV/resume
 * Cover letter explaining:




 1. Your interest in safety-critical security
 2. The type of position you envision based on your technical background
 3. How your speciﬁc skills would add value to our technical domains
 4. Sample from your portfolio demonstrating relevant technical skills.




*Unfortunately, we cannot process your application without a cover letter and a sample of your portfolio.




Applications are reviewed regularly. You can expect to hear from us within 5 business days. Promising candidates will be invited to discuss potential opportunities and might be asked to perform a hacking challenge.




If you have any questions regarding this (open) vacancy or your application status, please contact Rob via email at hrm@navinfo.eu*




* Unsolicited services or offers from recruitment agencies or intermediaries will not be responded to.

title: Sr. Security Incident Handler
description:
RDQ126R167

We are looking for experienced Incident Handlers with cross functional skills, domain expertise and communication skills. Our mission is to respond to security threats, incidents and investigations to protect our customers, employees and enterprise data in a fast, efficient and standardized manner. You will report to the Head of Incident Response in the Security Org. You will be responsible for leading incidents, investigations and security initiatives from postmortems in the EMEA or APAC timezone. You will be a security multiplier and help the team improve security incident handling at Databricks.

The Impact You Will Have


 * You will run Security & Privacy Investigations which will require you to engage with different stakeholders and communicate investigations to Security leadership and work towards incident resolution.
 * Respond to new incidents as part of a distributed daytime operations and on-call schedule.
 * Handle SEV-1s and SEV-0s independently, potentially with leadership support for SEV-0s.
 * You can guide investigations with multiple teams across multiple organizations, to gain traction and tradeoff to resolve issues.
 * You can handle incomplete incident context, and choose best solutions with limited or incomplete information.
 * Partner and build relationships with Engineering and Security teams to contain and mitigate risks during incidents
 * Lead blameless incident postmortems and identify root causes, including systemic issues.
 * Identify, get commitment for, and follow up on projects identified in the postmortem process.
   
   

What We Look For


 * Strong oral and written communication skills, customer centric attitude and ability to work in a culturally diverse environment.
 * 5+ years of experience in Incident Management Systems or certifications like CISM,GSEC, CISSP or PMP.
 * Program management skills, including prioritization and dealing with ambiguous requirements. You have experience to balance short term/ tactical follow ups and track long term improvements across multiple teams.
 * Experience with technical concepts of cloud security, data ecosystem and the Incident Response process lifecycle.
 * Understand industry wide security terms and models : NIST,ISO/IEC 27001, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud Enterprise.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

DEV/OPS Engineer with a Passion for Security, 32 - 40 hours per week, Hengelo

The Security Identity and Access Management (SIAM) Agile Squad at Thales Netherlands ensures our colleagues have access to high-quality SIAM applications that fully meet our company’s security standards. Based in Hengelo, we support all four Thales offices in the Netherlands.

About Your Future Job

As a SIAM Engineer, you’ll play a key role in managing and optimizing our SIAM tooling and processes. Your main goal is to keep our SIAM tools running smoothly, integrated seamlessly, and always improving. You’ll be working within a complex and dynamic environment, always with a security-first mindset.

Your main tasks will include


 * Integration: Helping to integrate SIAM tooling within our IT landscape.
 * System Management: Maintaining and administrating SIAM tools to ensure high availability, performance, reliability, and especially security.
 * Support & Troubleshooting: Providing technical support to users, resolving incidents quickly, and ensuring SIAM tools are running optimally.
 * Documentation: Creating and updating clear documentation around SIAM processes, system configurations, and best practices.
   
   
   

Who are we looking for?

We’re searching for a new colleague who enjoys working in a team and is motivated to develop further in the field of security. Ideally, you:


 * Have completed an HBO degree or have gained similar experience through several years of work.
 * Are enthusiastic about diving deeper into security responsibilities, aiming to become an expert in this area.
 * Have some experience with security tooling (for example vulnerability scanning, endpoint data sanitization, and detection/response tools) familiarity with OpsWat or NextPose is a plus. If not, we’re happy to help you develop these skills.
 * Have some knowledge of and are willing to learn more about the IAM domains such as IGA, PAM, or AM.
 * Understand the basics of Active Directory.
 * Have experience working in Windows or Linux server environments.
 * Like working in an Agile environment and are comfortable with a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration.
 * Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
 * Are available to work in a hybrid model, coming to our Hengelo office at least three days a week.
   
   
   

What’s in it for you?


 * A challenging job in a pleasant team within our high-tech, innovative work environment.
 * Shared responsibilities: in daily operations, every team member works on the IAM as well as the Security responsibilities of the team.
 * Possibilities for personal and professional development within the organization, for example on a technical, commercial, or international level.
 * Valuable international collaborations with colleagues from 68 countries.
 * A comfortable workplace in a modern environment, with attention to flexibility and the right work-life balance.
 * Work can usually be done where and when you want. Within Thales, we aim for a 60/40 balance, meaning you can work from home at least two days a week if your role allows.
 * A good salary, suitable travel expense reimbursement, and the possibility to personalize your employment conditions annually: you can trade leave days for internet costs, our bicycle plan, company fitness, and moving expenses.
 * 40 vacation days per year. Yes, really.
   
   
   

Interested?

Apply now by clicking 'Apply now'!

A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales IS/IT procedures.

Diversity Statement

We believe that your job should support the right work/life balance and be the platform to realize your ambitions. That means equal opportunities, inclusivity, and an informal culture are essential parts of our success. But also that your health and happiness are very important to us! That's why we offer you the flexibility to do what is important to you; whether that is working part-time, working from home, or the ability to be flexible with your start and end times, we think with you.

Security Requirements

In line with the basic security requirements of Thales, we may ask candidates for proof of identity, work permit, and employment plus education history. Some positions also require a security clearance that requires further information. For more information regarding what is required for certain security clearances, please refer to the General Intelligence and Security Service.

 * Experience with incident response procedures and able to articulate to customers how to integrate VersaONE’s visibility/reporting capabilities into their incident response playbook
 * Able to articulate various compliances such as PCI, HIPPA, SOC2, FedRAMP, etc. with customers and architect the VersaONE platform to meet these compliances.

 * Exceptional public speaking and C-Level customer consultative and relationship skills

Location: California, Colorado

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment in California, Washington, or New York City is expected in the range of $200,000 - $300,000 USD OTE. title: Docenten Cyber Security
description:
Locatie Amsterdam

Salaris € 4.361,- tot € 6.114,- op basis van een 36 urige werkweek

Dienstverband Parttime of fulltime, 16-40 uur

Contract Tijdelijk, met optie tot verlenging

Wil jij een baan met maatschappelijke impact? Met een goede work-life balans? Kennis overdragen en blijven werken aan een veiligere wereld? Jezelf steeds verder ontplooien, ontwikkelen en security kennis up-to-date houden? Samenwerken met jonge mensen, toonaangevende securitybedrijven en samenwerkingspartners? Lees dan verder!

Want waar anders dan bij de HvA …


 * is de impact van jouw werk veel groter dan bij een werkgever, klant of project
 * kun je kiezen voor 40+ vakantiedagen per jaar
 * maak je een carrière switch terwijl je nog geen onderwijservaring nodig hebt
 * draag je kennis en ervaring over terwijl je jezelf verder blijft ontwikkelen
 * werk je met jonge mensen samen en help je hen groeien
   
   

Dit zegt jouw toekomstige collega

“Er is niks mooier dan jongeren te zien groeien in het vak waar ik ook zelf een passie voor heb. Hiervoor werkte ik 30 jaar in het bedrijfsleven. Ik had toen niet verwacht dat ik als docent zo’n interessant netwerk zou opbouwen, laat staan dat ik zou bijdragen aan zeer innovatieve projecten en onderzoeken.” Tiemen Mink, teammanager en docent bij HBO-ICT.

Zo maak jij het verschil

Voor de HBO-ICT Associate degree, de Bachelor Degree en omscholingstrajecten, ontwikkel je, samen met het Cyber Security docententeam, onderwijs op het gebied van (technische) Cyber Security. Bijvoorbeeld over incident response, monitoring, ethical hacking, Malware, Cryptografie, Threat Intelligence en pentesten. Maar ook basiselementen van cybersecurity besturingssystemen zoals Linux en Windows, zoals het OSI model, TCP/IP en scripting in bash en python.

Je daagt studenten uit en verrast, motiveert en activeert hen, onder meer door de verschillende werkvormen die je inzet en die bij jou passen. Van werkcolleges tot practica en aansprekende projecten in samenwerking met het werkveld. Je hebt ideeën over hoe je de lesstof tot leven brengt. Je begeleidt en coacht in het leren, samenwerken, nieuwsgierig zijn en een onderzoekende houding aannemen. Samen werken jullie ook aan echte bedrijfsopdrachten. Van sommige studenten ben je ook de stage- of afstudeerbegeleider

Studenten leren in twee (AD) of vier (bachelor) jaar problemen herkennen en oplossen.

Binnen de HvA zijn volop kansen om jouw Security kennis up-to-date te houden. Je werkgebied is breed maar je kunt je ook specialiseren in een sub-onderwerp. Je werkt ook samen met docenten van andere curricula. Bovendien kun je meewerken met het CERT-HvA, SOC/SIEM en/of intiatieven met onze samenwerkingspartners. Een enorm scala aan kennis, onderwerpen en uitdagingen.

Nog geen ervaring in het onderwijs? Geen punt!

Je krijgt een buddy en een inwerktraject (0,5 - 1,5 jaar) dat volledig op jou is toegespitst. Ook loop je eerst mee met ervaren collega’s. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om je didactische bevoegdheid te halen. En wist je dat onze docenten een deel van hun werktijd en een mooi budget mogen inzetten voor hun vakinhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling?

Wat je verder krijgt


 * Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.361,- en € 6.114,- (schaal 11 cao hbo).
 * Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% en vakantiegeld van 8%van je bruto jaarsalaris.
 * De mogelijkheid om het vakantieverlof uit te breiden naar 428 vakantie-uren per jaar
 * Recht op verschillende soorten verlof, zoals (on)betaald ouderschapsverlof, zorgverlof, adoptie- en pleegzorgverlof en regelingen voor wat oudere medewerkers.
 * Afhankelijk van je situatie, kun je gebruikmaken van een van de volgende mogelijkheden: kilometervergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer, een NS-Business Card, een eigen HvA-fiets of belastingvoordeel bij de aanschaf van een andere fiets. Kun je, bijvoorbeeld vanwege een functiebeperking, niet met eigen of openbaar vervoer komen? Dan kijken we samen naar de mogelijkheden.
 * Korting op onder meer boeken, culturele cursussen, soft- en hardware en een aantal verzekeringen.
 * Volop aandacht voor werkplezier en werk-privébalans. En voor vitaliteit. Zo kun je voordelig deelnemen aan onze sportactiviteiten speciaal voor HvA-medewerkers of via sportcentrum USC. Ook kun je gebruikmaken van onze (loopbaan)coaches en van online tools die je ondersteunen bij je mentale gezondheid.
 * Een goede pensioenregeling bij ABP.
 * Een maandelijkse internetvergoeding en een laptop en telefoon in bruikleen.
 * Last but not least: een werkplek in een dynamische omgeving waarin je in een fijne sfeer met collega’s werkt, die je ook buiten het werk om kunt ontmoeten, bijvoorbeeld via onze community’s, zoals HvAPride, HvA Alumni, HvA United, JongHvA en FEM IT.
   
   

Bekijk hier al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en mogelijkheden op maat.

Zo verrijk jij ons

Op de HvA zijn geen twee medewerkers hetzelfde. Dus wie je ook bent, je vult ons team altijd aan. Voel je daarbij de drive om je kennis te delen en de wereld veiliger te maken? En wil je studenten verder helpen én je door hen laten inspireren? Dan heb je de belangrijkste skills voor deze baan al in huis. Daarnaast werk je graag samen en ga je net zo makkelijk zelfstandig aan de slag. Verder neem je mee:


 * Een afgeronde relevante Master of een relevante Bachelor met de bereidheid om een Masteropleiding te volgen
 * Meerdere jaren ervaring in technische cyber security materie
   
   

Word onze nieuwe Docent Cyber Security


 * Upload je motivatie en cv via de sollicitatiebutton. En houd je inbox in de gaten: binnen twee tot drie weken ontvang je een persoonlijke reactie.
 * Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Jacqueline de Werker kan je er alles over vertellen. Mail naar vacatures@hva.nl.
 * Deze vacature is gelijktijdig in- en extern gepubliceerd. Bij gelijke geschiktheid hebben interne kandidaten voorrang op externe kandidaten;
 * Voor meer informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je mailen naar vacatures@hva.nl.
 * Bij de werving en selectie ter invulling van deze vacature, houden wij de HvA Sollicitatiecode aan. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.
   
   

Creating tomorrow op de Faculteit Digitale Media en Creatieve Industrie / afdeling HBO-ICT

Vanuit onze campus in het hart van Amsterdam leidt de Faculteit Digitale Media en Creatieve Industrie studenten op voor een breed, internationaal werkveld. Bij ons kun je als medewerker en student alle kanten op; we zijn actief op het gebied van media, communicatie, digitaal design, ICT en mode. Hierbij werken we – onder andere via werkgroepen en onze Centres of Expertise – nauw samen met de creatieve industrie én een groot netwerk aan partnerinstellingen over de hele wereld.

In het Kenniscentrum volgen onderzoekers de digitale en technologische invloeden op onze maatschappij, en op Amsterdam in het bijzonder. De opgedane kennis kun jij weer verwerken in het curriculum.

Talent als basis, diversiteit als kracht

Van onze ruim 45.000 studenten en 4.500 medewerkers zijn er geen twee hetzelfde! Kun je je voorstellen hoe dynamisch dat is, die enorme verscheidenheid aan persoonlijkheden, achtergronden en perspectieven? Belangrijk ook, want wij geloven dat we juist dankzij die diversiteit beter presteren als werkgever én hogeschool van en voor de Metropoolregio Amsterdam. We streven ernaar de diversiteit die Amsterdam rijk is weerspiegeld te zien in ons personeelsbestand. En een organisatie te zijn waar elke medewerker en student zich welkom, gewaardeerd en thuis voelt. Dus wie jij ook bent: je bent van harte welkom!

title: Cybersecurity specialist
description:
Wil jij bijdragen aan een financieel eerlijke en transparante samenleving? Als cybersecurity specialist bij de AFM bescherm jij onze organisatie tegen cyberdreigingen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze informatie en systemen veilig blijven. Dit doe je samen met onze partners en collega’s. Je vertaalt nieuwe wetten en regels zoals NIS2 en DORA naar onze praktijk en helpt ons aan de juiste beveiligingsmaatregelen te voldoen. Uitdagingen die de cloud, AI, supply chain security en virtualisatie met zich meebrengen ga jij zeker niet uit de weg!




Jouw werk is belangrijk voor het vertrouwen in de financiële markten. Je voert risicoanalyses uit, houdt ons informatiebeveiligingssysteem actueel en helpt bij het oplossen van beveiligingsincidenten. Je bent altijd op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in cyber security en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen. Als innovatieve probleemoplosser met een datagedreven mindset draai jij je hand niet om voor het valideren van de beveiligingsregels, zoals bijvoorbeeld de IAM inrichting




Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

 * Beheren en verbeteren van het ISMS op basis van BIO2
 * Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses, tests en security assessments
 * Vanuit eerstelijns functie toezien op opvolging van auditbevindingen en verbeteracties
 * Monitoren en rapporteren over beveiligingsmaatregelen en incidenten
 * Bevorderen van security awareness binnen de organisatie




Interesse?

Dit vragen we:

⭐ Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van Informatiekunde, Informatica, Cybersecurity of een vergelijkbare studierichting

⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met het beheren en verbeteren van de security binnen een complexe organisatie

⭐ Aantoonbare kennis van cloud- en infrastructuurbeveiliging, met ervaring in Azure-omgevingen en bijvoorkeur met tooling zoals Sentinel en Defender

⭐ Je beschikt over certificering op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging zoals CISA, CCSP en/of CISSP

⭐ Sterk analytisch vermogen om risico’s te herkennen en te vertalen naar concrete maatregelen

⭐ Proactieve en resultaatgerichte werkhouding; je neemt initiatief en houdt overzicht

⭐ Goed kunnen samenwerken binnen multidisciplinaire teams en gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen




Wat we bieden:

📄 Je start met een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

💰 Een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €60.000 en €90.000 (36 uur, incl. 13e maand en vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

⏰ 36-urige werkweek, werkdagen in overleg (bijv. 4x9)

🌴 199,5 vakantie-uren per jaar (bovenop je standaard roostervrije dag)

💻 Een laptop en een smartphone

📚 Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden

🚆 Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas)

🏡 Thuiswerkvergoeding voor thuiswerkdagen

💪 Bijdrage aan een sportschoolabonnement

🚲 Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een fiets- en deviceregeling en vergoeding voor je thuiswerkplek




Meer informatie?

Voor vragen over de vacature neem je contact op met Linda Brandenburg (recruiter) via linda.brandenburg@afm.nl of 06-11799680.

title: Cyber Security Specialist
description:
Dit wordt je functie

Wil je meewerken aan de verbetering van de digitale veiligheid van APG en de bestrijding van cybercrime? Wil je werken in een uitdagende omgeving waar je veel kunt leren, ook over de nieuwste technologieën? Dit is je kans!

Wil jij je als Cyber Security Specialist breder ontwikkelen dan slechts een domein? Wil jij horizontaal en verticaal groeien? APG biedt een grootschalige en mede daardoor uitdagende IT-omgeving, waarbinnen je je optimaal kunt ontwikkelen. Ruime opleidingsmogelijkheden zorgen ervoor dat je je zowel vakinhoudelijk als op persoonlijk vlak goed kan ontwikkelen. Zo houd je de regie over je carrière. Als Cyber Security Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het uitvoeren van de dagelijkse operationele securityprocessen en de beschikbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en integriteit van onze infrastructuur zodat de informatiesystemen 24-7 optimaal functioneren. Zo worden onze klanten optimaal ondersteund.

De standplaats voor deze rol is Heerlen.

Functieomschrijving

Als Cyber Security Specialist kom je te werken op het SOC en monitor je dagelijkse de security meldingen. Je registreert en coördineert security incidenten en bewaakt de opvolging van gedetecteerde dreigingen en kwetsbaarheden. Daarnaast ben je actief bezig met het versterken van de cyber security systemen door middel van automatisering. Met jouw actuele kennis van cyber security help je om het securityproces verder te optimaliseren zodat deze probleemloos verlopen binnen de diverse afdelingen. Tot je taken behoren ook:


 * (Ondersteunen bij het) in kaart brengen van risico’s en dreigingen;
 * Automatiseren van cyber security processen;
 * Identificeren en ontwikkelen van nieuwe use cases;
 * Proactief bijdragen aan de verbetering van de security posture;
 * Inbedden van nieuwe processen en tooling binnen de afdeling;
   
   
   

Tot je rol behoort participatie in de 24-uurs stand-by en indien nodig, werk je buiten de reguliere kantooruren. Bij APG ga je werken bij de afdeling IT Security van de eenheid Shared Infrastructure Services, onderdeel van de APG IT organisatie. De IT-infrastructuur ondersteunt de APG-bedrijfsprocessen zodat o.a. de pensioenadministratie voor 4,5 miljoen Nederlanders en het vermogensbeheer goed uitgevoerd kan worden. We beschikken over een eigen datacenter en een uitwijklocatie met een zeer divers en complex IT-park o.a. bestaande uit duizenden systemen en een petabyte orde van grootte aan data. Met vestigingen in zowel New York als Hong Kong is ons netwerk internationaal. Je standplaats wordt ons kantoor in Heerlen.

Als Cyber Security Specialist ben je een professional die consequenties en implicaties van nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van cyber security overziet. Je hebt een proactieve houding en hebt passie voor alles wat met jouw vakgebied te maken heeft. Je hebt impact en weet jouw idee over de bühne te krijgen. Je wilt je graag blijven ontwikkelen, bent resultaat- en samenwerkingsgericht, initiatiefrijk en overtuigend. Door je groot analytisch vermogen en je sterke organisatorische vaardigheden ben je in staat om je werk gestructureerd, snel en zorgvuldig af te handelen.

Dit ga je doen

Als Cyber Security Specialist monitor je dagelijks de security meldingen. Je registreert en coördineert security incidenten en bewaakt de opvolging van gedetecteerde dreigingen en kwetsbaarheden. Daarnaast ben je actief bezig met het versterken van de cyber security systemen door middel van automatisering. Met jouw actuele kennis van cyber security help je om het securityproces verder te optimaliseren zodat deze probleemloos verlopen binnen de diverse afdelingen.

Dit breng je mee


 * HBO werk- en denkniveau;
 * Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring binnen het security domein, bij voorkeur Security Operations;
 * Ervaring met het opzetten en uitvoeren van operationele security processen waaronder security incident management, threat management, threat intelligence, en threat exposure;
 * Ervaring met tooling voor het uitvoeren van de operationele security processen (t.b.v. monitoring, testen en Security infomation en Event Management (SIEM) , Security Orchestration, Automation & Response (SOAR) etc.);
 * Certificering op het gebied van security zoals GSOC, of andere certificeringen van bijvoorbeeld GIAC;
 * Flexibiliteit en bereidheid om vanuit onze kantoor in Heerlen werkzaam te zijn.
   
   
   

Dit bieden wij

We bieden je, afhankelijk van relevante kennis en ervaring, een brutosalaris tussen de 3771 - 5388 EUR op basis van een fulltime dienstverband en mooie arbeidsvoorwaarden gericht op flexibiliteit, zoals:


 * Een gegarandeerde eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.
 * Veel aandacht voor jouw vitaliteit en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
 * Mogelijkheid om 2 à 3 dagen thuis te werken.
 * En uiteraard een goed geregeld pensioen.
   
   
   

Hier ga je aan de slag

Voor pensioenuitvoerder APG gaat pensioen over mensen, leven en samenleven. Met zorgvuldig vermogensbeheer, pensioenadministratie, communicatie en advies werken we aan een leefbare toekomst voor huidige en toekomstige generaties. Waarin we welvaart en welzijn eerlijk en duurzaam samen delen. Nu, straks, en later.

APG zet zich in voor zo'n 4,5 miljoen mensen in Nederland. Daarom vinden wij het belangrijk om ook een afspiegeling te zijn van de Nederlandse maatschappij. Dat betekent dat APG streeft naar een inclusieve werkomgeving, waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn én waarin jouw unieke kwaliteiten omarmd worden.

Als je kiest voor werken bij APG, kies je voor een baan waarin je bijdraagt aan een mooie toekomst. Solliciteer nu!

Meer informatie

Neem contact op met Fleur Van Lier - Weekers via, +31623382719 fleur.weekers@apg.nl of Kim Jakob middels kim.jakob@apg.nl die meer kan vertellen over de inhoud van de functie.

Zie jij toekomst bij APG? Solliciteer uiterlijk op 10-10-2025 en laat jezelf aan ons zien.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen wij niet op prijs.

title: Senior Cyber Security Specialist
description:
About Honeywell

JOB DESCRIPTION

Honeywell Building Automation refers to integrated systems and solutions that manage various building environments, improving operational efficiency, safety, and energy use. Key components include Building Management Systems (BMS), energy management tools, HVAC controls, security systems, and fire safety solutions. By utilizing IoT technologies, cloud computing, and data analytics, Honeywell enhances real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance capabilities. These solutions deliver significant benefits, including cost savings through optimized energy usage, enhanced comfort for occupants, regulatory compliance, and support for sustainability initiatives. Overall, Honeywell aims to provide intelligent systems that ensure efficient and safe building operations.

About The Job

Honeywell Building Automation team is looking for a motivated Senior Cyber Security Specialist with an interest in Operational Technology (OT) Security to join our Team in the Netherlands.

In this role, you will work with our Building Automation Cybersecurity team, gaining hands-on experience in real-world cybersecurity scenarios. Your responsibilities will include assisting in the development of cyber solutions, testing products, troubleshooting, implementing security measures, conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, and participating in cyber assessments while learning about standards such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, NIST 800-82, IEC62443 and ISO 27001.

You will report to the DACH/Benelux ICT/Cybersecurity Operation and work as part of a European / global Team.

Key Responsibilities


 * Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures for building automation systems
 * Assume the lead role in assigned projects, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to customer satisfaction.
 * Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify and address security gaps
 * Develop and execute cybersecurity strategies to protect against cyber threats
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the security of building automation solutions
 * Stay up-to-date with emerging cybersecurity trends and best practices
   
   

YOU MUST HAVE


 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
 * Minimum of 5 years of experience in OT/Cybersecurity engineering or related roles
 * Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices
 * Experience with vulnerability assessments and penetration testing
 * Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities
 * Fluency in Dutch and English Language
   
   

WE VALUE


 * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCNA, GICSP OR GIAC
 * Experience with industrial control systems and building automation
 * Familiarity with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443)
 * Strong communication and interpersonal skills
 * Ability to work effectively in a global and diverse team
   
   

WE OFFER


 * An excellent salary, a well-equipped car, laptop and phone (also for private use)
 * Immediate permanent contract with Honeywell with 40 vacation days (27 vacations and 13 ADV days), group discount, bicycle plan, expense allowance and good pension benefits
 * Development and growth opportunities
   
   

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Join a team recognized for leadership, innovation, and diversity!

#TheFutureIsWhatWeMakeIt

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

title: adviseur cyber security
Junior Technical Specialist
description:
Your Role as a Junior Technical Specialist




Location: Delft or Madrid




In short:




Kick-start your cybersecurity career with Fox-IT (part of NCC Group). You’ll help keep our customers’ security platforms running smoothly - mainly Splunk (SIEM) and EDR tools like Carbon Black, SentinelOne, and CrowdStrike. No prior Splunk/EDR experience needed: you’ll learn on the job with structured training and certifications.




You’ll join our Technical Operations (T-Ops) team of six in Managed Services, working closely with colleagues in the Netherlands, UK, and Spain.




What you will do:




 * Triage and investigate basic technical issues and alerts, following runbooks/playbooks.
 * Perform routine checks on Splunk and EDR platforms (health checks, basic admin tasks).
 * Log, update, and close tickets with clear notes; escalate when needed.
 * Shadow senior engineers and assist with slight changes (under supervision).
 * Document fixes and contribute to simple “how-to” guides for the team.
 * Take part in training and complete agreed certifications (we’ll support you).




Requirements:



 * 0–1 years’ experience in IT support, ops, or similar (internships and projects count).
 * Comfortable troubleshooting software/application issues (first-line or lab/project experience welcome).
 * Basic Linux knowledge is a plus (or keen to learn).
 * Curious, methodical, and happy to ask questions and collaborate.
 * Strong English communication and Dutch or Spanish is a plus.




Our Offer




You will work in a place at the top of cybersecurity where your ideas are valued. You may not always be able to share all the details about your work, but you can tell that you are contributing to a safer society. Additionally, we offer you:




 * A good salary that matches the things you have already done and will do.
 * Flexible working hours and flexibility working from home or at the office, allowing you to optimally combine your private life with your work.
 * A favorable pension scheme, twenty-six vacation days (+4 mandatory days off), and 8% holiday pay with a full-time contract.
 * Plenty of development opportunities: you can gain and share knowledge through training, TechTalks, events, and our own Fox Academy.
 * A laptop and business phone. If you use your own phone, you will receive a reimbursement of up to €25 per month.
 * A remote work allowance (for hybrid working).
 * A performance bonus and profit sharing because we value your effort.
 * When we work in the office, we gather every day for a delicious lunch.




Become a Foxer!




Do you recognize yourself in the above description and see the match? Let us know how you vision this! You can apply via the button below. You will then be directed to our ATS Workday, allowing us to process your application quickly.




Comprehensive screening is part of the onboarding process at Fox-IT.




Help from recruitment agencies, however well-intentioned, is (really) not needed.




Fox-IT




We are Fox-IT, also known as Fox. We stand for 'A More Secure Society.' Together, we are committed to making society safer through our technical and innovative solutions. From ethical hackers and incident responders to developers, security consultants, and more: we do this for organizations where cybersecurity is of significant importance.




We are critical thinkers, naturally security-minded, and love continuous development. We are part of the NCC Group, and together with 2,000 colleagues around the world, we work towards our mission of creating a safer world.




We have the mission to make our society safer. Our colleagues are the ones who make this possible; a global team of talented individuals working together towards a safer future.




We want to create an environment where everyone can reach their full potential. We work together, are immensely creative, embrace differences, and want you to be part of our mission.




About Your Application




We review every application and will contact you if your knowledge and work experience match what we are looking for. If you do not hear from us within 10 days, please do not be disappointed; we will keep your CV in our database for potential future vacancies and encourage you to keep an eye on our vacancies on our website. Feel free to apply for another position that appeals to you!




If you do not want us to keep your details, please send an email to global.ta@nccgroup.com. All personal data is stored in accordance with the NCC Group's privacy policy. We are committed to diversity and flexibility in the workplace. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.




If you need further modifications or additional assistance, feel free to ask!

title: Lead Cyber Security Operations Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced and technically skilled Lead Cyber Security Operations Specialist to take ownership of our Security Operations Center (SOC) and internal threat detection program. In this role, you’ll lead day-to-day security operations, drive incident response, manage vulnerability risk, and continuously improve our security posture. You’ll also lead internal vulnerability testing and collaborate across IT and engineering teams to identify, assess, and mitigate risk across infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper, is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now has officially become a unicorn company with a valuation of $1 billion following a successful funding round by Index Ventures. With over 500.000 users in 160+ countries and offices in Amsterdam, New York, Kuala Lumpur, Tokyo and Mexico City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there!

What You Will Do


 * Lead and coordinate daily SOC operations, including threat detection, investigation, containment, and remediation.
 * Manage and execute the vulnerability management program, including scheduling, scanning, reporting, and risk prioritization.
 * Conduct internal vulnerability testing and validation, including manual verification and exploit simulation where appropriate.
 * Collaborate with IT, DevOps, and application teams to ensure timely remediation of critical vulnerabilities.
 * Act as the technical escalation point for complex security incidents and provide hands-on response support.
 * Lead development and optimization of detection logic, response playbooks, and automated workflows (SOAR).
 * Drive proactive threat hunting and behavioral analysis using SIEM, EDR, and threat intelligence feeds.
 * Monitor and tune systems to reduce false positives and enhance detection efficacy.
 * Stay current on CVEs, zero-days, APTs, and threat actor techniques to inform internal defense strategy.
 * Provide executive-level reporting on security incidents, vulnerability trends, and operational KPIs.
 * Ensure security tools and configurations align with policy, compliance, and risk objectives.
   
   

What You Bring


 * 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, with at least 2 years in a Senior Analyst or Lead role.
 * Demonstrated experience managing and operating a vulnerability management program (e.g., Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7).
 * Hands-on experience with internal vulnerability testing, security assessment tools, and remediation planning.
 * Advanced knowledge of incident response, SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar), and endpoint detection (e.g., CrowdStrike, SentinelOne).
 * Strong familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, CVSS, OWASP Top 10, and security frameworks (NIST, CIS).
 * Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
 * A curious mind and eagerness to keep learning and experimenting.
   
   

Nice To Have


 * Relevant certifications: CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, OSCP, or similar.
 * Proficiency in scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to automate tasks and improve workflow efficiency.
 * Experience with SOAR platforms and integrating security tooling.
 * Exposure to cloud-native security tools in AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
   
   

What We Offer


 * Being part of the fastest-growing scale-up in the Netherlands.
 * Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us.
 * 28 vacation days on a full-time basis.
 * Excellent salary.
 * Pension plan.
 * Stock participation plan.
 * Hybrid mode of work (at least 3 days on-site in our Amsterdam office).
 * A flexible and growing organization with lots of opportunities to learn and develop.
 * International working environment, with a team of friendly and driven colleagues.
 * Office in Amsterdam with daily lunch included ( we have a chef cooking for us).
 * Access to OpenUp, the mental health and wellness platform.
 * Friday drinks and multiple social activities for team building 🤩
   
   

Recruitment Process


 * 30-minutes call with the recruiter.
 * 45-minutes call with the Hiring Manager.
 * Assessment
 * Offer
   
   

If this sounds interesting to you, please apply. We can’t wait to meet you!

title: Cyber Security Internship (Offensive & Defensive Security)
Security Engineer
description:
Why work at Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud computing to serve the global AI economy. We create the tools and resources our customers need to solve real-world challenges and transform industries, without massive infrastructure costs or the need to build large in-house AI/ML teams. Our employees work at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure alongside some of the most experienced and innovative leaders and engineers in the field.




Where we work

Headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Nasdaq, Nebius has a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, North America, and Israel. The team of over 800 employees includes more than 400 highly skilled engineers with deep expertise across hardware and software engineering, as well as an in-house AI R&D team.




Position Overview:

Nebius is seeking an experienced and proactive Security Engineer to spearhead the security posture of our critical data center environments. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and mitigating security risks, defining and implementing robust security controls, and leading the continuous monitoring and improvement of our data center security infrastructure. You will play a vital role in protecting our assets and ensuring the integrity and availability of our services by managing security measures at the intersection of our data centers and external networks, including internet-facing communication.




Key Responsibilities:

 * Security Gap Analysis: Proactively identify, assess, and prioritize security vulnerabilities and gaps within our data center environments, including network infrastructure, physical security interfaces, and critical systems.
 * Security Control Definition & Architecture: Define and document security requirements for essential controls such as Firewalls (FW), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Database Firewalls (DBF), Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), and other relevant security technologies for data center ingress/egress points and internal segmentation.
 * Deployment Support & Integration: Collaborate with infrastructure and network teams to support the seamless deployment, configuration, and integration of new and existing security controls within the data center.
 * Continuous Monitoring & Improvement: Develop and implement strategies for the continuous monitoring of security controls and data center network traffic. Analyze security events, investigate incidents, and drive improvements to enhance detection and response capabilities.
 * Threat Intelligence Integration: Oversee the ingestion, analysis, and operationalization of real-time threat intelligence feeds to proactively defend against emerging threats targeting data center infrastructure.
 * Auditing & Compliance: Plan, conduct, and support internal and external security audits related to data center operations. Ensure compliance with relevant security standards, regulations, and best practices.
 * Incident Response: Act as a key stakeholder and technical lead during security incidents impacting the data center environment.
 * Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation for security architecture, control configurations, operational procedures, and audit evidence.




Required Qualifications & Skills:

 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 * Proven experience (3+ years) in network and infrastructure security, with a strong focus on data center environments.
 * Demonstrable experience in a leadership or mentorship role.
 * In-depth knowledge of network security principles, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, etc.), and common attack vectors.
 * Hands-on experience with designing, implementing, and managing security controls such as Firewalls , WAFs ,DBFs and DDoS protection
 * Strong understanding of threat intelligence platforms and their application in a data center context.
 * Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
 * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.




Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

 * Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM).
 * Experience with cloud security principles and how they might interact with on-premise data centers.
 * Experience working in large-scale, geographically distributed data center environments.

title: Security Engineer (F5)

title: Security engineer
description:
Jij maakt Quooker

 * Met jouw kennis omtrent IT security zorg jij dat Quooker een up to date en sterk informatiebeveiligingsbeleid heeft.
 * Je hebt een scherpe geest en kunt snel complexe informatie verwerken en analyseren.
 * Jouw nieuwsgierigheid en besluitvaardigheid zorgt ervoor dat je adequaat handelt op nieuwe informatie.




Als Security engineer ontwerp, bouw en onderhoud je de beveiligingssystemen binnen Quooker. Je zorgt dat Quooker een sterk informatiebeveiligingsbeleid heeft en organiseert dat het risicomanagement hieromtrent adequaat is georganiseerd. Dat deze regelmatig wordt aangepast, maakt de functie voor jou nóg interessanter. Ontwikkelingen zie jij als welkome uitdagingen waar je maar al te graag je tanden in zet.




Naast het configureren en beheren van de beveiligingstools en -software, test je regelmatig de beveiliging van systemen.

Je vertaalt risico's naar technische oplossingen die je samen met je IT collega's en (interne) stakeholders gaat implementeren. Begrijpen van de bedrijfsprioriteiten is daarbij een must.




Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt complexe concepten vertalen naar heldere boodschappen voor een ieder binnen en buiten Quooker. Je begrijpt onze organisatiestructuur en -cultuur en kunt hierdoor perfect inspelen op de belangen van alle betrokkenen.

Doordat je jouw kennis up to date houdt en trends en innovaties snel signaleert, ben je proactief als het gaat om (privacy) verbetertrajecten.




Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

 * Een cultuur waar jij centraal staat doordat we waardering & feedback durven uit te spreken zodat je precies weet waar je aan toe bent.
 * Investering in jouw ontwikkeling door opleidingen en maatwerk coaching.
 * Hybride werken en dat betekent 4 dagen in Ridderkerk en 1 dag thuis.
 * Een unieke werkomgeving waar je jouw ideeën in de praktijk werkelijkheid ziet worden.
 * Werken met een duurzaam product en het recyclen van oude producten (tip: luister deze aflevering van ‘Op Stoom’ de podcast over onze uitdagingen op het gebied van circulariteit).
 * Elke dag gratis vers fruit en gezonde, betaalbare bites in ons bedrijfsrestaurant.
 * Borrels, uitjes en feesten.
 * Vitaliteitsprogramma en sportvergoeding van €25,- per maand.
 * Een abonnement op Pluralsight.




Over jouw team




Quooker zet de komende jaren in op een verdere digitalisering en we kunnen jouw hulp goed gebruiken. Een schets van het IT-team: een gedreven en gezellig team dat bestaat uit een helpdeskmedewerkers, twee werkplekbeheerders, verschillende applicatiebeheerders (meet Erwin!) en applicatiespecialisten, drie systeembeheerders, drie software ontwikkelaars, een projectmanager en één IT Manager. Ambities en kwaliteiten van medewerkers staan voorop om het IT-team verder te laten groeien.




Werken bij Quooker




Quooker is op missie om de wereld te veroveren! We zijn vastberaden deze missie te laten slagen. Die vastberadenheid bevindt zich al in ons DNA sinds 1970: toen Henri Peteri de eerste kokendwaterkraan uitvond. Zijn idee moest en zou een succes worden. En dat lukte. Je past dus goed bij ons als je een aanpakker bent en doorzettingsvermogen hebt.

De kraan die alles kan heeft zich ontwikkeld als een onmisbare tool in de keuken. Door onze ambitie om innovatief en orgineel te blijven, voorziet de kraan vandaag de dag niet alleen in 100c kokend water maar ook in gekoeld én bruisend water.

We bedenken, produceren en verzenden de kraan hier, vanuit Nederland. Alles onder één dak. We zijn graag onafhankelijk, houden van korte lijnen en varen onze eigen koers. Ieder van onze collega's draagt op unieke wijze bij aan het succes. Ze doen compleet verschillende dingen, maar vormen samen een geheel. Benieuwd naar hun rol, drijfveren en ambities? Hier lees je hun verhalen.

De Quooker kraan is uitgevonden om ons dagelijks leven, maar ook het milieu te dienen. Makkelijk voor de mens, vriendelijk voor de planeet. We kennen onze verantwoordelijkheid en nemen deze ook.




Wat verwachten wij van jou?

 * minimaal 3-5 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring in vergelijkbare rol;
 * HBO werk- en denkniveau;
 * uitstekende kennis van Nederlands en Engels (in woord en geschrift);
 * Communicatief sterk, oplossingsgericht en flexibel
 * Kennis van wet- en regelgeving, zoals de AVG en de NIS2, ISO27001
 * Gedisciplineerd en nauwkeurig
 * Sterke analytische vaardigheden en goed in staat om risico's te identificeren en te evalueren
 * Diepgaande kennis van diverse IT systemen zowel on prem als in de cloud zoals:
 * CIS Policies
 * Networking
 * Vulnerability scanning
 * Microsoft Defender en andere antivirus/malware oplossingen.
 * IOT
 * CIAM
 * Azure

title: SIRT Team Lead – Security Incident Response Team
description:
Introduction to the Job

As Security incident response team lead, you will take a leadership role within the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT). Your primary focus will be on leading a team of security analysts and play a key role in shaping ASML’s security posture.

Role And Responsibilities

The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) operates within the Security Operations Center (SOC) to detect and mitigate security threats in real time. As a SIRT Team Lead, you will be responsible for people management, operational security monitoring and security improvements.

You will manage team(s) performance during daily operations and provide process and technical guidance to team members across the board. You coordinate staffing and resource allocation of team members across end-to-end SIRT operations and collaborate with Service Delivery Management for specialist track capacity management and empower end- to-end process execution.

Role

The team of security analysts consists of diverse areas of expertise security incident response (Cyber, IT, OT, DLP, Physical), threat hunting, and driving strategic security improvements. You will play a key role in mentoring security analysts and shaping the organization’s security posture. The main focus points of the role of SIRT team lead:


 * Develop & grow your team members to support wider ranges of security incidents and become more valuable and well-rounded security analysts.
 * Identify and implement process level improvements in the team and strengthen the collaboration across ASML together with the rest of the leadership team.
 * Ensure high quality analysis, documentation and resolution on all security incidents managed in your team aligned with a common documentation way of working across the ASML Security incident management workflow.
   
   

Education And Experience

This position requires deep tactical, people management expertise, with a balanced technical knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to understand complex security investigations and lead security improvements. The ideal candidate will have:


 * Strong team development & coaching focus.
 * Strong stakeholder management and build solid relationships of trust at different levels.
 * 8+ years of management experience, preferably in a multinational corporate security environment.
 * Proven experience with security monitoring & incident response activities.
 * Broad experience in multiple security domains (e.g., IT, Information, Operational Technology (OT) or Physical Security.

Skills

title: Privacy Assurance & Certification Specialist
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Privacy Assurance & Certification Specialist

Job Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Privacy Assurance & Certification Specialist to support the advancement and oversight of our global privacy assurance and governance programs, with a focus on Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs) and other Privacy, AI and Data certifications. This role will contribute to key assurance activities and collaborate across different teams to drive Privacy, AI and Data governance practices, support audit readiness, enhance awareness, and facilitate knowledge-sharing within internal privacy and audit teams.

A solid understanding of global Privacy, AI and Data regulations is essential; prior experience with BCRs/ ISO certifications is a plus. The preferred candidate will have a strong interest in operationalizing and standardizing Privacy, AI and Data governance, risk and compliance processes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


 * Certification & Project Management
 * Contribute to the governance and maintenance of Privacy, AI and Data frameworks and certifications, including BCRs and APEC CBPRs. Support the expansion of BCRs and other certifications to new entities and countries, including implementation of controls, risk remediation, project management and planning.
 * Privacy Assurance & Controls Monitoring
 * Manage and support privacy assurance activities, including testing of controls, monitoring implementation, and evidence gathering in alignment with Mastercard’s Privacy, AI and Data policies and processes.
 * Privacy Risk Assessment
 * Support the execution of global Privacy and AI risk assessments by helping identify, document, and monitor risks and mitigation strategies as part of existing or new certifications.
 * Audit
 * Assist with internal and external audits by engaging with relevant stakeholders, gathering and reviewing required documentation, coordinating responses across teams, and tracking remediation of controls’ findings.
 * Training & Awareness
 * Deliver BCRs-focused awareness sessions for relevant first line, second line and third line of defense stakeholders.
 * Provide guidance on audit processes and audit readiness.
 * Keep internal teams informed on relevant regulatory developments and emerging topics regarding Privacy, AI and Data certifications.
 * Stakeholder Engagement and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 * Collaborate with cross functional teams (e.g., Legal, InfoSec, Compliance, Product) to ensure consistent understanding and implementation of Privacy, AI and Data governance processes.
 * Knowledge Management & Regulatory Awareness
 * Maintain up-to-date documentation related to BCRs, CBPRs, and other Privacy, AI and Data certifications. Monitor relevant changes in global Privacy, AI and Data laws (e.g., GDPR) and developments in the global BCRs landscape, and ensure alignment of internal policies and processes.
   
   
   

Qualifications

Required:


 * Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Information Security, or a related field.
 * Minimum 2 years of experience in audit, assurance, risk, or governance functions — preferably in a privacy or data protection context.
 * Solid understanding of global Privacy, AI and Data regulations, including GDPR, APEC CBPR and BCRs.
 * Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
 * Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities.
   
   
   

Preferred


 * Experience with cross-border data transfer frameworks (e.g., BCRs, CBPRs).
 * Familiarity with privacy assurance or audit standards (e.g., ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISAE 3000).
 * Professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISA, or equivalent.
   
   
   

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


 * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
 * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
 * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Network Security Expert
description:
Nice to know (you)


 * Je bewaakt de digitale grenzen van ons bagagesysteem binnen een OT/IT-omgeving en werkt met moderne securitytechnologie aan systemen die direct impact hebben op de veiligheid en continuïteit van Schiphol.
 * Je bent onderdeel van een team dat veiligheid en innovatie combineert.
 * Met ruim 3.500 trotse collega’s werken we aan onze missie: ‘the world’s most sustainable and high quality airports’.
   
   
   

Connecting your world

Als Network Security Expert ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de netwerkarchitectuur en cybersecurity van het Baggage Control System. Je beheert firewalls, VLAN’s, VPN’s en netwerksegmentatie. Je voert risicoanalyses uit, implementeert beveiligingsmaatregelen en reageert op incidenten. En hoe je dit aanvliegt? Dat is aan jou. We vertrouwen op de manier waarop jij zorgt voor de juiste balans. Dit lukt je ook als de situatie hectisch of stressvol is. Jouw talenten zet jij in bij het:


 * Verzamelen en beoordelen van bewijslast richting SCSC (Schiphol Security Coordination Center).
 * Deelnemen aan wekelijkse cybermeetings waarin afwijkingen en verdachte activiteiten besproken worden.
 * Beheren van netwerkwijzigingen – elke aanpassing aan het netwerk moet traceerbaar zijn en worden vastgelegd.
 * Fungeren als kennisdrager op het gebied van netwerkcommunicatie en apparatuur binnen industriële omgevingen.
 * Signaleren van actuele dreigingen en adviseren over passende maatregelen.
 * Inventariseren van technische behoeften en deze, samen met het team en leveranciers, vertalen naar praktische en uitvoerbare oplossingen.
 * Controleren of eisen correct worden nageleefd door derde partijen en leveranciers.
 * Opstellen en bijhouden van documentatie met betrekking tot uit te voeren changes.
   
   
   

Verder werk je als Network Security Expert nauw samen met IT-beveiliging, leveranciers en operations om te zorgen dat het systeem veilig, stabiel en toekomstbestendig blijft. Je adviseert over architectuur, compliance en technische standaarden.

You've got this

Schiphol verbindt jouw wereld. Met de beste mensen maken we reizen veilig en verantwoord. Jij draagt hieraan bij met jouw unieke talenten, zoals de manier waarop jouw werk (en als het nodig is dat van anderen) tot in detail analyseert en dubbelcheckt en hoe jij soepel sterke banden met anderen opbouwt . Sowieso heb je voor deze functie:


 * Hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau in netwerkbeheer, cybersecurity of vergelijkbaar.

 * Kennis van firewallregels, VPN’s, SteppingStone, segmentatie en toegangscontroles (IAM, Identify & Access Management) Ervaring met monitoringtools, SIEM, IDS/IPS en loganalyse.

You get this


 * € 4981 tot € 6911 bruto per maand (Schaal 12).

Dit zijn nog maar een aantal van onze arbeidsvoorwaarden die horen bij deze functie (op basis van een 36-urige werkweek). Schiphol Group heeft jou nog meer te bieden. Ga voor het totale overzicht van alle arbeidsvoorwaarden naar Arbeidsvoorwaarden - Werken bij Schiphol Group.
